text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. 1-inch Electronic Personal Photo(JPG format) * 2. Passport photocopy A clearly visible copy of your valid passport with name, photo, birth date, place of birth, date of issue, and date of expiry. Visa page is required for applicants who are currently living outside their own country of residence. The passport validity period must be after March 1st, 2027. The passport can not be changed after the submission of the application until enrollment. * 3. Non-Criminal Record Notarized Chinese or English translation is required for non-Chinese and English versions. * 4. Chinese proficiency test certificate * 5. High school graduate certificate Please provide High School graduation certificate. Copies of the original certificate with the school’s official stamp and/or the signature of the principal. If the originals are not in Chinese or English, they must be translated and notarized. * 6. High school academic transcript Please provide High School transcripts of all grades. Copies of the original transcript with the school’s official stamp and/or the signature of the principal. If the originals are not in Chinese or English, they must be translated and notarized. * 7. Personal Statement An essay statement written in English or Chinese on one page of A4 size paper. Introduce why you are applying for, describe your interest and enthusiasm for the chosen major or research field, and how your previous studies or experiences relate to it. Describe what makes you suitable, such as relevant skills,experience, or achievements gained from previous education, work, and other activities. * 8. TWO Recommendation Letters -Must be written in Chinese or English by professors or associate professors (for master’s and Ph.D. applicants) or teachers from your last university or high school (for bachelor’s applicants). -Letters must include the recommender’s name, contact information (email and phone), and handwritten signature (no typed signatures). -Please make the letters as official as possible. -If you plan to apply to multiple universities, do not mention the name of a specific Chinese university in the letter, to avoid rewriting for each application. * 9. Statement of Financial Support -Download the template attached -The statement should be completed by the applicant and his/her sponsor, then be signed, scanned and uploaded online as one of the application documents. You can download a template or sample from here . * 10. Foreigner Physical Examination certificate (Valid in 6 months) Applicants should strictly follow the requirements of the Physical Examination Record For Foreigner and provide a detailed report of blood examination. Incomplete records, those without the signature of the doctor, the official stamp of the hospital or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. You can download a template or sample from here . 11. A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -The video should be at least 2 minutes long, in MP4 format, and less than 7 MB. -Include a brief self-introduction, your study plan after enrollment, reasons for applying to this program and university in China, and your plans after graduation. -You may also highlight your language ability, interests, confidence, and motivation. * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
